simple.meaning: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רֹאשׁ (H7218) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 600 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רֹאשׁ (rôʼsh) means the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 42.
